subject: Protecting Chevalier Auditorium From Encore Casino Expansion
overview: The Council requested funding for specialized legal representation to challenge Encore Boston Harbor's expansion plans, which they identified as an existential threat to the Chevalier Auditorium. The body also addressed construction site nuisances, zoning recodification, and requested a legal opinion on municipal salary laws.

items.title: OB's Auto Service license hearing
items.summary: Approved a Class 4 automotive repair and auto body shop license for OB's Auto Service at 38 Harvard Avenue.

items.title: Legal opinion on salary and budget laws
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a City Solicitor opinion on whether municipal salary increases and new positions require a two-thirds council vote under Massachusetts General Law.

items.title: Lawrence Road construction site concerns
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting building department inspections and a committee hearing to address safety, trash, and snow removal violations at a development on the corner of Lawrence Road and Forest Street.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital commendation
items.summary: Commended Lawrence Memorial Hospital for being named one of the top 100 hospitals in America for patient care.

items.title: Prestige Car Wash traffic and noise
items.summary: Referred Prestige Car Wash to the Subcommittee on Signs to discuss traffic gridlock, signage, and the use of outdoor audio systems.

items.title: Chevalier Auditorium legal funding
items.summary: Approved a request for the Mayor to allocate $2,500 for specialized legal counsel to challenge Encore Casino's expansion before the Gaming Commission. Councilors argued the city's current law firm has a conflict of interest because they also represent the City of Everett.

items.title: East Border Circle repairs and pothole plan
items.summary: Approved a resolution for immediate repairs on East Border Circle and the creation of an emergency city-wide pothole repair program.

items.title: Committee reports: Polystyrene and zoning
items.summary: Approved Committee of the Whole reports concerning the proposed polystyrene container ordinance and 71 zoning recodification recommendations from the Community Development Board.

items.title: Public participation: Council authority and HR position
items.summary: A resident questioned the Council's role in advocating for state-level legislation and inquired about the legal status of the city's Human Resources Director position.
